physical_arsenal.field_utility: Secures itself to deep coastal seafloors against surging currents, using its heavy anchor as an unyielding mooring point while hunting.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Swings its massive iron anchor like a heavy flail, generating crushing kinetic force amplified by its spirit-infused kelp.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Scavenges sea-bottom detritus and metal scrap, gradually altering shipwreck sites by stripping them for its own physical growth.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Felled a fully grown ocean leviathan in a single physical blow before siphoning its remaining energy in seconds.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Exercise extreme caution when diving near underwater shipwrecks trailing green vegetation. If an anchor or steering wheel shifts independently, ascend immediately to avoid being dragged into the depths.

species_relations.field_context: Dhelmise ambushes passing Wailord from the sea floor, wrapping them in kelp to drain their massive reserves of life force.
Maintains a calm cohabitation with Skrelp, granting them physical protection within its iron frame while benefiting from their natural camouflage.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Pseudo-legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Historically revered by ancient warriors for their unflinching battle etiquette, Jangmo-o stubbornly refuse to show an enemy their back.

overview.field_thesis: High in isolated mountain ranges untouched by human hands, Jangmo-o spend their days in endless, honorable sparring duels to temper their spirits and scales. They communicate across vast alpine valleys by clanging their armored crests against surrounding rock faces.
key_observations: Smacks its hardened forehead crest against stone to broadcast distinct metallic signals to distant kin.
Engages in ritualized, head-on dueling with flockmates, gradually strengthening skull plates through repeated impact.
Maintains a strict martial ethos, refusing to retreat or expose its rear to any challenger.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: The reinforced forehead plate functions as a sturdy chisel for carving out shelter ledges along shear cliff faces.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Absorbs direct physical collisions with its specialized head plate, turning incoming blows into devastating forward charges.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Rhythmic, metallic head-clangs echo across mountain peaks for miles, signaling active sparring grounds to nearby travelers.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Repeatedly headbutts solid granite ledges with sufficient kinetic force to startle mountain predators without suffering scalp injury.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If you hear metallic ringing echoing off mountain crags, remain where you are and state your presence clearly. Fleeing or turning your back will provoke Jangmo-o into issuing an immediate head-on sparring challenge.

species_relations.field_context: Young Jangmo-o observe mature Kommo-o from high perches to master complex scale-clashing cadences and traditional combat stances.
Regularly clashes with roaming Pawniard patrols over access to sharp rock outcroppings used for scale-sharpening.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Pseudo-legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Hakamo-o drives the physical weight of its dense scale armor directly into strikes, easily tearing through opponent hides and splintering solid rock.
It claims steep canyon ledges and aggressively defends them, clanging its scales in a fast rhythm and roaring to ward off any intruding wanderers.

overview.field_thesis: Hakamo-o is an aggressive martial dragon that continuously hardens its body through relentless dueling and skin-shedding cycles. It heralds its attacks with loud acoustic scale-clashing, building to an energetic crescendo before charging down its prey.
key_observations: Continuously sheds and regrows its metallic body scales, with each successive regrowth layer emerging harder and sharper than before.
Clashes its scales together to generate a rising percussion beat, using the absolute peak of the rhythm as a signal to strike.
Displays scar tissue and unarmored patches of skin to defeated foes as proud proof of surviving harsh combat.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: The heavy, heat-conductive scales shield vital organs against fall injuries on loose scree slopes while effortlessly venting body heat during extended mountain sprints.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: By coiling its limbs and launching scaly fists, it inflicts sharp blunt-force trauma while its thick armor absorbs retaliatory impacts and kinetic blows.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: The intense metallic rhythmic ringing generated by a territorial Hakamo-o reverberates across rocky valleys, triggering small gravel slides and driving smaller wild species away.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Rhythmically slams its body scales together to produce a disorienting acoustic burst, using the shockwave to stun its target right before executing a high-leaping body slam.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If metallic percussion echoes along the trail ahead, freeze immediately and begin a slow retreat. Never collect metallic shed scales left on mountain rocks, as nearby Hakamo-o consider scavenging inside their territory an explicit declaration of war.

species_relations.field_context: Hakamo-o frequently picks sparring matches with younger Jangmo-o to force the juveniles to shed and harden their soft initial scale layers.
Hakamo-o observe mature Kommo-o from a respectful distance, modeling their fighting stances and percussion rhythms after these fully realized leaders.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Pseudo-legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: It aggressively patrols high-altitude ridges, shaking its tail scales to project a metallic chime that warns off intruders long before physical contact.
Kommo-o drives scale-encrusted fists straight through solid granite, delivering devastating uppercuts that can launch heavy adversaries off cliffside ledges.

overview.field_thesis: Kommo-o is a solitary, honorable apex predator inhabiting steep alpine peaks, easily recognized by the continuous metallic ringing of its scale armor. It spends its days guarding mountain territories and challenging any resilient traveler or wild beast that refuses to back down from its sonic displays.
key_observations: Jingles its hollow metallic tail scales to broadcast a deafening warning chime before initiating physical combat.
Spares and ignores weak or fleeing targets, reserving its devastating martial blows exclusively for steadfast foes.
Celebrates major territorial victories by howling into the wind, triggering answering scale-clatter echoes from nearby kin across distant peaks.

primary_assets: Interlocking metallic scale plates across head, torso, and limbs
Reinforced steel-dense fist scales optimized for martial strikes
Resonant, rattle-like tail scales designed for acoustic amplification
physical_arsenal.field_utility: The thick scale coat insulates Kommo-o against freezing alpine winds, rockfalls, and projectile blasts while navigating treacherous mountain faces.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Kommo-o relies heavily on close-quarters boxing maneuvers, channeling massive kinetic force into sweeping uppercuts while using its rigid plating to deflect direct counterattacks.

innate_powers: High-frequency sonic wave generation via scale vibration
Kinetic blast dissipation through acoustic scale dampening
special_capabilities.environmental_impact: A full-force scale rattle sends shockwaves through the air that trigger mountain rockslides and shatter fragile cliffside ice formations.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: A fully charged acoustic howl coupled with a scale-boosted uppercut can shatter boulder barricades and produce sound pressure loud enough to rupture human ear drums.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If you hear rhythmic, metallic jingling echoing down a canyon, halt immediately. Do not run in sheer panic, as Kommo-o ignores fleeing targets; calmly step back down the path to demonstrate non-aggression and avoid triggering its warrior instinct.

species_relations.field_context: Kommo-o harshly drives young Jangmo-o away from comfortable lower slopes, forcing them to train and harden their scales in isolation near mountain peaks.
Kommo-o frequently clashes with Skarmory over high-altitude perches near metallic ore veins used to strengthen their respective metallic hides.
Both species are revered in ancient warrior lore as symbols of discipline and honor, frequently depicted together in ruin murals.

classifications.justification: Electric Surge setter boasting 130 base Speed, enabling fast Volt Switch momentum, Taunt disruption, and Electric terrain offenses. It historically shut down sleep-inducing strategies on turn one.
Classified as a Sub-Legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Patrols Melemele Island with fierce vigilance, relentlessly driving off intruders with overwhelming lightning before abruptly losing interest.
Summons localized thunderclouds directly overhead to draw high-voltage bolts into its outer shell to replenish its reserves.

overview.field_thesis: Tapu Koko is the mercurial, lightning-fast guardian deity of Melemele Island whose extreme curiosity is matched only by its hair-trigger temper. It spends its days darting across island ridges and harvesting storm energy to maintain its high-speed aerial posture.
key_observations: Can fold its interlocking wooden shell around its torso to form a stylized avian head that insulated its inner body.
Exhibits extreme mood volatility, shifting from curious observation to aggressive attack and back to total forgetfulness in moments.
Saturates the local terrain with raw electrical power upon entering battle, making ground-based targets prone to immediate shock.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: The heavy shell halves serve as insulating body armor against extreme lightning discharge and environmental debris during storm flights.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: By snapping its shell shut around itself, Tapu Koko forms a streamlined battering ram that deflects attacks while focusing raw electrical bursts out the front.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Its presence ionizes the surrounding air, making ground-level vegetation hum with static electricity and causing hand-held radios to short out.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Accelerates beyond visual tracking speed to strike a target with storm-grade voltage before the sound of the thunderclap even reaches the observer.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Show utmost respect if you spot Tapu Koko on Melemele Island. Avoid aggressive movements or sudden noise, as its temper flares without warning and its lightning blasts can vaporize camp gear instantly.

species_relations.field_context: Tapu Koko violently defends Melemele Island's ecosystem against alien Ultra Beast invaders, engaging in explosive high-speed dogfights.
While Tapu Koko represents sudden lightning and restless motion on Melemele, Tapu Bulu embodies steady, sluggish growth on Ula'ula.

classifications.justification: Sets Psychic Terrain to protect teammates from priority moves while supercharging Psychic-type damage. Choice Specs-boosted Psyshock and Expanding Force frequently OHKO neutral targets before they can move.
Classified as a Sub-Legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Serves as Akala's ancient tutelary deity, holding domain over local territorial sanctuaries and natural energy balance.
Absorbs fragrant floral scents across tropical groves, refining pollen into concentrated psychokinetic energy.

overview.field_thesis: Tapu Lele is the guardian spirit of Akala Island, widely known for shedding glittering scales that instantaneously heal physical wounds. However, its whimsical nature masks a complete lack of empathy, making it prone to inflicting severe distress through innocent over-curiosity.
key_observations: Absorbs the sweet perfumes of dense floral blooms to fuel its psychoactive energy reserves.
Sheds glowing scales that rapidly close flesh wounds, though excessive exposure induces overwhelming physical strain.
Retreats entirely within its durable outer shell when resting or erecting defensive psychokinetic barriers.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Closes its shell into an impenetrable casing to withstand harsh weather and external attacks during deep rest.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Uses unattached hands to weave complex psychic forcefields while remaining safely shielded behind its primary shell.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Saturates the local ambient air with psychokinetic force, preventing priority physical strikes and sharpening mental energy.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Blankets battlefields in a dense mist of luminescent scales, fully restoring weary allies while over-stimulating adversaries.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Do not misinterpret Tapu Lele's playful, fluttery demeanor for mildness; keep your distance if illuminated scales begin floating nearby, as contact can cause unpredictable metabolic surges.

species_relations.field_context: Stands alongside Melemele's guardian in regional lore, contrasting aggressive lightning strikes with whimsical mental force.
Frequently descends upon Comfey roosts to siphon sweet floral scents gathered in their flower ring wreaths.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Sub-Legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Viciously obliterates any human settlements or invaders that breach or disrespect its sacred jungle grounds.
Spurs wild flora into rapid, explosive growth, reshaping whole woodlots and absorbing bio-energy from the vegetation it creates.

overview.field_thesis: Tapu Bulu is a sluggish yet formidable spirit that governs the dense forests and mountains of Ula'ula Island. While usually content to nap peacefully in sunlit clearings, it unleashes terrifying physical and botanical force against anyone who threatens its territory.
key_observations: Rings the bell-like appendage on its tail while moving through the forest to alert travelers and avoid unnecessary conflict.
Uproots massive trees by hand to swing as makeshift bludgeons during high-intensity battles.
Will ruthlessly raze human structures to the ground if built upon land it considers holy or forbidden.

primary_assets: Heavy wooden shell capable of interlocking into an impenetrable defensive carapace
Hardened, forward-facing horns used for brutal gore strikes
Tremendous physical upper-body strength suited for uprooting full-grown trees
physical_arsenal.field_utility: It uses its immense muscular strength to clear debris, carve out secluded sunbathing spots, and uproot massive timber for nest construction.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: In combat, it locks itself into its dense wooden casing to absorb violent impacts before counter-attacking with horn charges or swung tree trunks.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Its presence causes the forest floor to blossom instantly with thick grass and vines, saturating the air with vibrant, woodsy energy.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Commanded a dense wall of roots to completely flatten an intrusive commercial building, reverting the site back to wild woodland in minutes.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If you hear a wooden bell ringing through the canopy, stop immediately and retreat. Respect all boundary markers and avoid harvesting timber or disturbing ruins within its forest domain.

species_relations.field_context: Serves alongside Tapu Koko as a fellow island guardian, balancing Koko's frantic hyper-activity with its own sluggish, deliberate composure.
Drives off intrusive Gumshoos packs whenever their territorial patrols disrupt the peace of its sacred forest clearings.

classifications.justification: Misty Surge blankets the field to prevent all grounded Pokémon from being afflicted with status conditions like Burn or Sleep. It sets up Calm Mind behind immense natural bulk and chips teams down with Muddy Water and Moonblast.
Classified as a Sub-Legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Functions as the ancient divine warden of Poni Island, drawing raw vital energy directly from deep ocean currents.
Envelops its sanctuary in impenetrable mist, punishing dishonest or reckless trespassers with severe divine misfortune.

overview.field_thesis: Tapu Fini is an elusive marine deity that governs the foggy, current-carved waters surrounding Poni Island. It spends its days immersed in thick sea mist, using purified water to cleanse corrupted environments while fiercely repelling unworthy intruders.
key_observations: Draws physical energy and supernatural vitality directly from deep ocean currents.
Generates dense, magical fog that causes complete sensory deprivation and leads confused adversaries to ruin.
Capable of producing pristine, purified water capable of washing away mental and physical impurities.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: The heavy shell closes completely around its body, offering total protection against intense oceanic pressure and crushing wave impacts.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Snapping its rigid shell shut forms an impenetrable defense against enemy strikes, allowing it to safely discharge high-pressure water streams.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Saturates the local air with dense, sparkling mist that pacifies aggressive impulses and nullifies hazardous status conditions.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Summons crushing oceanic torrents paired with thick fog banks capable of completely disorienting and trapping encroaching vessels.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Never attempt to enter the dense fog banks around Poni Island without explicit reverence. Uninvited explorers face total disorientation, sudden hydrokinetic surges, and mysterious calamities.

species_relations.field_context: Stands alongside Tapu Koko as an island guardian, contrasting Koko's hot-headed combativeness with cold, calculated detachment.
Shares divine duties within the Alolan archipelago, remaining solemn and distant where Lele displays whimsical cruelty.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Standard Species based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Observations confirm this species enters our ecosystem through localized space-time tears, sharing no evolutionary lineage with native wildlife.
Spends its days drifting passively to sweep air particulate and ambient light directly into its gaseous body.

overview.field_thesis: Cosmog is an extra-dimensional spore that drifts passively on wind currents while gradually absorbing ambient atmospheric dust. Unaware of basic environmental hazards, it wanders with innocent curiosity, relying strictly on reflexive spatial warps whenever threatened.
key_observations: Weighs virtually nothing, allowing mild sea breezes to blow it miles off course without interrupting its calm demeanor.
Displays a complete lack of self-preservation instincts, often floating directly toward dangerous predators out of pure interest.
Triggers emergency spatial wormholes to warp its body to safety the moment it experiences severe physical distress or surprise.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its nebula-like vapor envelope acts like a physical sponge, gathering microscopic starlight and atmospheric particles to slowly build up body density.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Lacks conventional physical striking tools, allowing standard physical impacts to pass harmlessly through its gaseous cloud.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Leaves faint trails of shimmering micro-particles in the sky that temporarily disrupt local magnetic readings.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Instantly opens an emergency warp tear, teleporting its fragile body several miles across terrain to escape incoming danger.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Cosmog poses zero physical danger to humans, though its fragile body and habit of wandering into dangerous territory mean explorers should actively shield it from harsh winds and local predators.

species_relations.field_context: Ancient texts revere Cosmog as the initial seed form that eventually matures into the radiant sun-bearing deity Solgaleo.
Historical records link Cosmog to the delicate larval stage of the moon-bearing sovereign Lunala.
Necrozma aggressively targets Cosmog to siphon away the extra-dimensional light energy stored within its cloud-like membrane.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Standard Species based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Passively vacuuming starlight, radiation, and ambient air dust into its core at all hours to condense power for its next stage.
Hails from Ultra Space, possessing a compressed core and gravitational density foreign to terrestrial biology.

overview.field_thesis: Cosmoem is a completely motionless cosmic pupa that remains suspended in space or resting on ancient altars while quietly siphon-feeding on atmospheric particulate and light. Though utterly inert to the touch, its black central mass constantly compresses absorbed starlight to fuel its imminent, explosive evolution.
key_observations: Remains entirely stationary and uncommunicative, emitting only a faint heat signatures from its core.
Continuously draws in fine atmospheric dust and ambient light like a microscopic gravitational sink.
Possesses an outer golden shell that exhibits structural density unmatched by any earthly metal or crystal.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: The outer husk provides absolute physical insulation, protecting the delicate core from deep-space vacuum, atmospheric re-entry friction, and terrestrial weathering.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Incapable of direct physical strikes, it relies entirely on its supreme structural density to absorb kinetic impacts and energy blasts without taking damage.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Creates a localized thermal glow and minor atmospheric drawdown as ambient particulates are pulled into its shell.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Maintains a weight of nearly a ton within a body less than fifteen inches wide, remaining perfectly floating or immovable regardless of outside forces.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Cosmoem will never attack a traveler, but setting its immense mass down on unstable ground can easily collapse flooring or cause severe crushing injuries if handled improperly.

species_relations.field_context: Represents the dormant, condensed intermediate stage of the volatile gaseous form Cosmog once possessed.
Serves as the solar path of evolution when Cosmoem matures under intense daylight energy.
Serves as the lunar path of evolution when Cosmoem matures while bathed in nocturnal starlight.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Box Art Legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Opens rift tears in spatial reality with its crown, enabling seamless movement between Ultra Space and our world.
Venerated across island mythologies as a divine protector that drives off existential dark forces with boundless solar radiance.

overview.field_thesis: Solgaleo is a massive, ultra-terrestrial lion clad in dense metallic armor that produces infinite solar energy. It travels across dimensional barriers, capable of illuminating entire regions in midnight dark with the brightness of midday.
key_observations: Exudation of intense light turns nighttime environments into broad daylight instantly upon activation.
Opens spatial tears known as Ultra Wormholes, occasionally bringing extra-dimensional organisms with it.
Enters its Radiant Sun phase when releasing maximum energy, causing its forehead symbol to shine like a third eye.

primary_assets: Full metal outer hide immune to external stat disruption
Massive heavy-impact paws capable of shaking tectonic plates
Prismatic mane crest that focuses solar particle beams
physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its dense, impermeable body lets it stride through extreme pressures, toxic atmospheric vents, and cold spatial voids without harm.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Leverages its dense frame to deliver crushingly heavy charges and Earth-shaking leaps that smash solid stone to powder.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Surges ambient temperature across vast radii while flooding local biomes with brilliant light, disrupting nocturnal feeding habits.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Ignites into a radiant meteor during Sunsteel Strike, piercing through enemy defenses regardless of their protective abilities.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Never look directly at Solgaleo when its crown eye glows white. The light output can cause instant thermal burns and permanent blindness. Maintain extreme distance if a spatial tear opens nearby.

species_relations.field_context: Serves as the solar counterpart to Lunala, balancing regional atmospheric energy in ancient Alolan lore.
Sought out by Necrozma, which attempts to bind with Solgaleo to siphon its vast solar light to restore its lightless core.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Box Art Legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Feeds by constantly siphoning ambient light from its immediate environment, turning daylight into localized night.
Capable of opening unstable Ultra Wormholes to jump between dimensions and summon foreign life-forms.
Revered throughout ancient Alolan history as a divine protector that governs the lunar night and balances solar light.

overview.field_thesis: Lunala is a massive, bat-like legendary entity that feeds by siphoning ambient light directly out of the sky. When fully charged, it glows like a deep midnight moon and can tear open tears in space-time to travel between worlds.
key_observations: Plunges surrounding terrain into sudden, dark shadows by rapidly draining all local photic energy.
Activates a third eye on its forehead to focus its energy and open wide Ultra Wormholes.
Exhibits an iridescent wing pattern that mirrors a star-filled sky when storing full power.

primary_assets: Forehead crown housing a third eye organ
physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its massive wing sails catch atmospheric light waves and high-altitude cosmic currents, enabling silent, long-distance gliding.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Sweeps down with its blade-like wing tips while its shadow shield diffuses incoming attacks, drastically reducing impact damage.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Consuming light causes rapid temperature drops and total darkness across entire valleys in a matter of seconds.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Enters its Full Moon phase to discharge storehouses of light energy into a concentrated beam capable of piercing through spatial dimensions.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If sunlight vanishes instantly without cloud cover, Lunala is actively feeding above you. Avoid using high-intensity spotlights or flares, as concentrated light sources will draw its immediate attention and trigger destructive energy siphon responses.

species_relations.field_context: Acts as the lunar counterpart to Solgaleo, maintaining environmental balance by managing night cycles while Solgaleo governs the day.
Necrozma ruthlessly targets Lunala to forcibly absorb its light energy and regain its lost ultimate form.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Enters our ecosystem exclusively through spatial ruptures known as Ultra Wormholes.
Physically attaches to host organisms to siphon their vitality while hijacking their central nervous system.
Injects a specialized neurotoxin that strips away a target's natural inhibitions and induces intense aggression.

overview.field_thesis: Nihilego is an invasive, drifting organism from another dimension that hunts by seeking out suitable host bodies. Once a target is selected, it uses mind-altering venom to manipulate the host's actions while feeding off its life energy.
key_observations: Composed of a flexible, glass-like bell structure that feels like cold smooth stone rather than soft tissue.
Exhibits unsettling movements that occasionally mimic human gestures or the body language of a young child.
Lacks visible eyes or internal organs, navigating instead through energy sensing and airborne chemical cues.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: The flexible glass bell drifts silently on thermal currents while soft, heavy tentacles hang below to snag prey from above.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Wraps its tentacles tightly around a target's head or torso, using microscopic barbs to lock itself in place during combat.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Sheds fine toxic mineral dust as it moves, contaminating the immediate surroundings and causing dizziness in nearby wild life.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Directly floods a host's bloodstream with poison, triggering an uncontrollable adrenaline surge and explosive violent outbursts.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Keep your distance if you spot a floating glass-like bell. Never permit its tentacles to touch your neck or head, and wear a sealed respirator in wormhole drop zones to prevent inhaling neurotoxic spores.

species_relations.field_context: Where Clefable represents benevolent lunar folklore, Nihilego represents the dangerous reality of invasive extraterrestrial predators.
Competes in coastal drop zones where both species rely on paralyzing venom to secure prey.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Arrived in our ecosystem through localized wormhole disruptions known as Ultra Wormholes.
Documented pulverizing heavy construction vehicles and armored machinery with a single offhand punch.

overview.field_thesis: Buzzwole is an invasive alien organism that combines the predatory siphon habits of a mosquito with terrifying physical strength. It roams unfamiliar territory constantly striking exaggerated muscular poses, which serve as both an alien communication method and an outright threat to anything in its path.
key_observations: Performs elaborate, continuous muscle flexing routines toward allies, enemies, and inanimate objects alike.
Uses its lance-like proboscis to drain energy, causing its red thoracic sacs and limb muscles to swell to double their size.
Demonstrates complete indifference to conventional physical hazards, stepping through steel bar-fences and rock slides effortlessly.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its four multi-jointed legs allow it to vault over dense forest canopies, while its needle-like mouthparts easily drive through solid steel plating to reach fluids beneath.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Channels absorbed fluids directly into its strike limbs, delivering catastrophic kinetic impacts that obliterate armor while absorbing physical counters through dense muscular padding.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: High-frequency wing beats generate localized pressure waves that can blow the roofs off buildings and shatter surrounding glass.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Completely flattened a fully loaded, multi-ton dump truck with a single direct straight punch.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Never assume its striking poses are a sign of friendliness. Maintain a wide perimeter and call local authorities immediately if an Ultra Wormhole opens in your area—do not attempt physical combat.

species_relations.field_context: Shares a native Ultra Space origin, representing absolute brute force alongside Pheromosa's blinding speed and grace.
Drawn to Machamp territory by mutual displays of physical flexing, resulting in intense territorial rivalries over power supremacy.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Emerged directly from an atmospheric rift, displaying severe behavioral aversion to terrestrial soil and native lifeforms.
Generates kinetic kicking force capable of snapping concrete beams despite its paper-thin leg structure.

overview.field_thesis: Pheromosa is a hyper-velocity invasive predator from another realm that treats terrestrial dirt and life with complete revulsion. It darts across landscapes at speeds that exceed visual tracking, neutralizing perceived threats with devastating, needle-precise kicks.
key_observations: Sprints at velocities high enough to generate vacuum trails that collapse light vegetation in its wake.
Refuses to rest its full weight on muddy or unrefined ground, constantly levitating or balancing on microscopic contact points.
Produces a subtle, hypnotic pheromone that temporarily stupefies nearby observers before it strikes.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its thin, gleaming limbs act as tension springs, allowing it to cross uneven terrain instantly without accumulating dirt or debris.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Unleashes torrential High Jump Kicks and Triple Kicks, using extreme momentum to break dense armor while effortlessly dodging counterattacks.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Rapid directional changes produce sharp sonic snaps that shatter nearby glass and disorient wildlife within a fifty-meter radius.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: DODGED point-blank thunderbolts while sprinting across a damp marshland without leaving a single impression in the mud.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Maintain extreme distance if an Ultra Wormhole breach occurs. Pheromosa perceives any physical proximity from native life as an insulting contamination and will deliver high-velocity, lethal strikes to clear its path.

species_relations.field_context: Dispatched alongside Buzzwole in high-tier rift events, contrasting its blinding, delicate speed against Buzzwole's dense, brute physical mass.
Exhibits intense revulsion toward urban scavengers like Alolan Raticate, violently launching them out of its path whenever encountered.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Emerged through Ultra Wormhole breaches, demonstrating a physiology completely foreign to native biological systems.
Roots its lower appendages deep into the soil or power grids to continuously absorb ground voltage and atmospheric charges.

overview.field_thesis: Xurkitree is an otherworldly entity composed of dense, flexible bundles of electrical wiring that functions much like a living, metallic tree. It wanders blindly until locating high-voltage power sources, whereupon it anchors its limbs to drain localized energy reserves down to the bedrock.
key_observations: Stands rigid and motionless for hours in open fields, easily mistaken for an extra-dimensional utility pole until approached.
Lacks traditional facial features or sensory organs, navigating entirely through electro-receptive fields emitted from its glowing bulbous head.
Raids industrial substations during nightfall, causing regional blackouts as it draws massive currents into its central core.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its flexible wire tendrils can constrict targets with immense force or drive deep into concrete and earth to anchor the organism against high winds.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Uses its cable-like arms to wrap tightly around opponents, channeling lethal voltage directly into their tissues upon contact.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Discharges localized electro-magnetic pulses that fry unshielded electronics and ionize the surrounding air, creating a constant odor of ozone.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Drained a regional power plant's entire secondary transformer bank in under three minutes, instantly overloading its internal core to unleash a blinding Zap Cannon.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Maintain a distance of at least fifty yards if you spot a static, metallic tree-like frame. Do not wear metal gear near an active Xurkitree, as its high electro-static field can arc across open air without warning.

species_relations.field_context: Competes directly with wild Electabuzz packs over control of sub-station power lines and high-voltage transmission towers.
Siphons stored bio-electricity directly from Charjabug colonies found clustered beneath forest canopy floors.

classifications.justification: A nearly unbreakable Steel/Flying defensive tank that stalls out entire teams with Leech Seed, Protect, and Beast Boost defensive buffs. Heavy Slam deals heavy damage against lightweight fairy and support Pokémon.
Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Arrived through Alolan Ultra Wormholes, hailing from an alien dimension where its massive species occupies a regular ecological niche.
Generates planetary orbital launch speeds and intense thruster fire capable of incinerating entire woodland ecosystems during takeoff.

overview.field_thesis: Celesteela is a gargantuan, plant-metallic Ultra Beast that behaves like a self-contained biological rocket, drifting passively through high altitudes between long resting cycles. When taking flight or defending its territory, it ignites compressed internal gases, converting atmospheric fuel into catastrophic launch fire.
key_observations: Stores highly volatile, pressurized gas within two giant, hollow metallic arm conduits.
Achieves orbital escape velocity without needing external launch structures or propulsion fuel.
Roots its central column into soil between flights to siphon minerals and organic moisture.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: The hollow arm conduits double as pressurized thruster nozzles and flight stabilizers, while its rooting base anchors its multi-ton frame into terrain during feeding phases.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Fires intense pressurized gas blasts, delivers crushing aerial drop attacks, and channels siphoned thermal or solar energy directly through its arm cannons.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Igniting its thrusters creates localized thermal shockwaves and forest firestorms, while its rooting siphons heavily deplete soil nutrients nearby.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Generates sufficient kinetic thrust through its arm nozzles to punch through the ozone layer and enter low planetary orbit.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Never approach a grounded or resting Celesteela. Its initial takeoff ignition releases a half-mile radius thermal exhaust wave capable of incinerating trees, gear, and flesh in seconds.

species_relations.field_context: Both originate from Ultra Space and possess organic-mineral structural traits, though Celesteela operates through sheer titan scale while Kartana relies on precision cutting.
High-altitude ascents by Celesteela into the upper atmosphere frequently trigger aggressive territory defenses from native high-orbit apex predators.

classifications.justification: Boasts a staggering 181 base Attack stat, slicing through teams with Leaf Blade and Sacred Sword while snowballing Attack boosts via Beast Boost. Access to Tailwind gives it both offensive and support speed utility.
Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Emerging directly from dimensional wormholes, this organism floats passively through our world while possessing edges capable of cleaving solid matter.

overview.field_thesis: Kartana is an invasive extra-dimensional entity whose paper-thin, metallic-cellulose body acts as an indiscriminate, atom-splitting blade. Though it rarely shows intentional hostility, its effortless movements shear through trees, bedrock, and human structures simply by making contact.
key_observations: Anatomy consists of compressed plant fibers and metallic sheen, rendering it almost weightless in atmospheric currents.
Documented severing a massive steel communication tower in a single, casual floating pass.
Rides ambient breezes to conserve energy, drifting silently until forced to maneuver.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its paper-thin profile allows it to glide on wind currents, while its edges clear dense terrain or rock barriers instantly as it moves.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Channels high-velocity wind and immense structural sharpness into lethal slicing moves like Leaf Blade, cutting cleanly through armor before targets can react.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: As it drifts, it leaves behind perfectly flat, razor-sharp shear lines across forest canopies, soil, and man-made structures.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Completely cleaved a multi-ton industrial steel girder with a light, non-contact brush of its arm-blade.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Never attempt to intercept, grab, or approach Kartana. Its body is sharp along every edge, and even slight wind gusts can push it into you with enough momentum to cause deep, surgical lacerations.

species_relations.field_context: Coexists as a fellow Ultra Beast, standing as a weightless paper blade counterpart to Celesteela's massive, heavy metallic structure.
Bisharp packs immediately yield their ground upon encountering Kartana, as their hardened steel plating offers zero protection against its edge.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Emerges directly from rift wormholes connecting to distant extra-dimensional realms, destabilizing native ecosystems with its unnatural presence.
Employs two massive, appendage-like pincers and overwhelming physical mass to crush structural concrete and bedrock prior to ingestion.

overview.field_thesis: Guzzlord is an extra-dimensional anomaly defined by an insatiable, ceaseless hunger that compels it to consume all organic and inorganic matter in its path. Despite its staggering intake of debris, buildings, and soil, field teams have never discovered any trace of biological waste.
key_observations: Possesses two gigantic tongue-like pincers that extend outward to drag surrounding terrain directly into its colossal maw.
Exhibits zero waste production; everything consumed appears to be converted instantaneously into pure energy or bodily growth.
Originates from a ruined alternate dimension where its species appears to be a common, albeit ecosystem-clearing, organism.

primary_assets: Colossal cavernous central maw lined with crushing sensory projections
Pair of extendable muscular pincers capable of gripping heavy machinery
Dense armored hide resilient to extreme kinetic impacts and thermal stress
physical_arsenal.field_utility: The extendable pincers sweep wide swathes of land, tearing up trees, topsoil, and concrete structures to funnel them directly into its mouth without pausing forward movement.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: In combat, its immense body mass effortlessly dampens incoming blows, while its heavy pincers deliver crushing grappling strikes and tectonic slams.

innate_powers: Beast Boost energy surge triggered upon overwhelming a target in combat
Total internal matter conversion capable of disintegrating dense minerals
special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Leaves behind completely flattened, hollowed waverings where local geography once stood, stripping soil down to exposed bedrock.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Documented consuming an entire multi-story concrete building and the adjacent asphalt roadway in under an hour, leaving no residual scrap.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Evacuate immediately upon any Ultra Wormhole alert in your vicinity; do not attempt to protect gear or land, as Guzzlord ingests its surroundings indiscriminately and cannot be reasoned with.

species_relations.field_context: In devastated urban ruins, Guzzlord rapidly consumes the massive refuse mounds that Garbodor rely on for food and body mass.
Where Kartana precision-cleaves obstacles into fine slivers, Guzzlord indiscriminately swallows whole structures, illustrating contrasting extra-dimensional behaviors.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Box Art Legendary based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Traverses Ultra Wormholes to enter foreign ecosystems, leaving lightless, starved wastes in its wake.
Continuously drinks ambient photon radiation, plunging surrounding land into sudden shadowy darkness.

overview.field_thesis: Necrozma is an ancient extra-dimensional organism composed of pitch-black crystalline prisms that survives exclusively by consuming light energy. Deprived of illumination, dark impurities build up across its body and freeze it into dormancy, driving it to thrash about in violent, laser-emitting frenzies whenever light is detected.
key_observations: When light-deprived for extended periods, black calcification locks its joints, forcing it into deep subterranean hibernation.
Its focal visor acts as a biological prism, refracting ambient photons into lethal laser beams that slice clean through stone.
Shows extreme neural agitation while starving, aggressively hunting any glowing creature or artificial light source regardless of danger.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its sharp, dark-hued crystal facets function as photon traps, drawing in faint background radiation across all wavelengths to prevent its crystalline circulatory system from solidifying.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: The obsidian armor diffuses incoming elemental energy and kinetic shocks via internal refraction, while its rigid claws deliver crushing physical blows.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Siphons every lux of local light upon arrival, causing nearby temperatures to plummet while casting an eerie, unnatural shadow over the terrain.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Focuses stored light into concentrated laser streams capable of carving wide glass trenches through solid bedrock.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Never ignite lanterns, flares, or electric gear if subterranean tremors suggest Necrozma is present. A starving specimen will ruthlessly obliterate any light source and everything standing beside it.

species_relations.field_context: Necrozma aggressively stalks Solgaleo across dimensions to devour its intense solar energy and restore its missing form.
Necrozma hunts Lunala across ultra-space, seeking to drain its cold lunar radiation to sustain its failing core.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Mythical Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Employs its Soul-Heart to align its consciousness with surrounding humans, intuitively tending to emotional and physical suffering.
Built as a royal gift, it remains bound by centuries-old programming to shield its designated charges from harm at any cost.

overview.field_thesis: Magearna is an ancient mechanical automaton powered entirely by a central sphere of concentrated life energy known as the Soul-Heart. Rather than roaming wild habitats, it spends its existence quietly aiding human companions and folding into a compact sphere when dormant or damaged.
key_observations: Completely lacks vocal cords, relying on hand gestures, glowing optic cues, and emotional empathy to communicate.
Capable of retracting its head and limbs into its dress-like lower chassis to form an impenetrable Poké Ball shape during rest.
The Soul-Heart embedded in its chest gathers biological energy from surrounding life, amplifying its power when allies faint.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its durable metal casing insulates its delicate internal gears from weather and physical impacts while allowing it to tuck away safely during transport.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Converts its body into an armored sphere using Defense Curl, deflecting heavy kinetic blows before deploying concealed beam emitters to counterattack.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Emits a faint, comforting warmth and light during emotional synchronization, while full energy discharges can leave scorched furrows in stone terrain.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Focuses the full output of its artificial soul into Fleur Cannon, unleashing a devastating beam of pink fairy energy that reshapes the immediate landscape.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Magearna is profoundly gentle and naturally disinclined to violence, but its internal light and beam weapons can discharge reflexively if its chest casing or Soul-Heart is forcibly tampered with.

species_relations.field_context: Shares responsibilities in historic estates and medical centers, relying on shared empathetic perception to maintain harmony.
Often studied together by artisans seeking to contrast modern industrial gear assembly with ancient alchemical automaton design.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Mythical Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Slips undetected into the shadows of martial artists and native wildlife to replicate their physical forms and combat techniques.
Wanders unseen across ecosystems without maintaining a stationary lair, living entirely submerged within shifting ambient darkness.

overview.field_thesis: Marshadow is a reclusive spectral predator that spends its existence submerged within the ambient shadows cast by living hosts. By silently observing and mimicking the movements of powerful fighters, it perfects its own combat techniques while remaining utterly unseen.
key_observations: Remains completely intangible while merged into host shadows, rendering standard visual tracking useless.
Duplicates physical reflexes and martial stances in real-time, eventually optimizing the movements to exceed the host's performance.
Exhibits extreme aversion to direct light when unmerged, actively seeking shadowed crevices or large host organisms.

primary_assets: Reinforced strike-points on hands and feet
physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its fluid physical mass allows it to collapse into flat surfaces and slide effortlessly through tiny gaps in rock or dense foliage.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Channels concentrated kinetic pressure into rapid punch combinations, using its spectral body to absorb blunt force without taking damage.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Causes sudden drops in localized floor temperature and subtle warping of light around the host shadow it currently occupies.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Infiltrated the shadow of an elite martial artist, copying their physical techniques so perfectly that it stripped away the fighter's momentum and turned it against them.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If your shadow appears slightly misaligned or moves out of sync with your body, freeze immediately and cast a direct light on the ground. Marshadow is timid by nature and will vacate your footprint without conflict when directly exposed.

species_relations.field_context: Marshadow frequently stalks wild Machamp from their shadows, analyzing their power-focused grappling stances to develop counter-techniques.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Arrived in our ecosystem through extra-dimensional wormholes, originating from a distant realm devoid of natural sunlight.
Giddily sprays sticky, caustic poison from its cranial needles whenever excited, coat-painting its immediate surroundings.

overview.field_thesis: Poipole is an inquisitive extra-dimensional organism beloved as a partner creature in its homeworld of Ultra Megalopolis. In the field, it floats buoyantly through the air, treating its adhesive venom like paint to mark its path with bright, cackling displays.
key_observations: Displays an extraordinarily high, child-like emotional intelligence and quickly bonds with sympathetic human handlers.
Cackles with delight while drenching terrain or opponents in sticky, glowing purple liquid.
Stores pressurized fluid inside a large, hollow cranial dome topped with sharp syringe-like needles.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Uses its cranial syringes to spray brightly colored toxic marks onto vertical surfaces, establishing temporary perches and communicating with visual graffiti.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Hovering just out of reach, it fires rapid streams of sticky venom that bind enemy limbs and irritate bare skin before darting away.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Coats rocks and trees in slow-drying, luminous venom that dramatically alters local soil chemistry if left unneutralized.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Generates enough hydraulic pressure inside its skull casing to launch a continuous barrage of venom over fifty paces while spinning inverted mid-air.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Exercise caution if a wild Poipole begins giggling or hovering erratically overhead; its toxic spray is extremely sticky and requires heavy alkaline solvents to scrub clean.

species_relations.field_context: Poipole represents the vibrant juvenile phase of the species, maintaining a playful nature before metamorphosing into the massive, aggressive dragon Naganadel.
Hails from the same extra-dimensional metropolis where Necrozma absorbed all ambient light, shaping Poipole's evolutionary drive to seek human partnership.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Emerge through local spatial rifts, exhibiting hyper-aggressive behavior native to the hostile biomes of Ultra Space.
Stores hundreds of liters of luminous, highly adhesive poison inside its lower abdomen, spraying it under intense hydraulic pressure.

overview.field_thesis: Naganadel is an invasive, draconic apex predator originating from an alternate realm known as Ultra Space. It hovers on leathery wings, raining down sticky, pressurized venom from the massive needle-lance on its lower abdomen.
key_observations: Stores hundreds of liters of glowing, toxic liquid inside its enlarged abdominal sac.
Fires a highly adhesive venom that sets quickly, binding prey in place while inflicting deep envenomation.
Demonstrates high-G aerial mobility, executing sharp dives and strafing runs above target zones.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Uses its adhesive toxic secretions to coat surfaces, securing nesting territory and immobilizing large prey items.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Skewers opponents with its primary caudal needle or drenches targets in glowing toxic liquid via high-pressure bursts.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Coats nearby terrain in luminous sludge that glues vegetation and taints local ground soil long after engagement.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Discharges hundreds of liters of sticky, glowing venom in mid-air strafing runs without losing speed or control.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If an Ultra Wormhole manifests, clear the LZ immediately. Naganadel's venom glues targets to the ground instantly, leaving no room for retreat.

species_relations.field_context: Naganadel acts as the primary protector and mature focal point for groups of unevolved Poipole in their native Ultra Space ecosystems.

classifications.justification: A premier anti-Trick Room Trick Room setter, utilizing ultra-low Speed to fire off maximum-power Gyro Balls. Beast Boost allows it to snowball physical Attack or Defense with every knockout.
Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Observations confirm this organism entered our world directly through an open Ultra Wormhole rift.
Hundreds of individual brick life-forms function as a single hive-mind structure, synchronizing their weight and movement flawlessly.

overview.field_thesis: At first glance, Stakataka resembles an ancient masonry tower, but it is actually a massive extra-dimensional colonial organism built from hundreds of individual brick-like entities. Emerging into our world through spatial wormholes, it remains stationary to blend into stone ruins before using its immense weight to crush anything that threatens its territory.
key_observations: Every individual brick unit possesses its own glowing eye that flashes red when agitated or preparing to strike.
The tower can seamlessly shift its weight and mass, allowing it to move with surprising stability despite its towering height.
When threatened, all constituent units align their outer walls into an almost completely seamless, dense metallic-stone barrier.

primary_assets: Hundreds of independent ocular brick units
physical_arsenal.field_utility: The individual brick units can shift to form overhangs, seal openings, or brace the structure against extreme seismic force and harsh atmospheric pressures.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: In combat, it leverages its colossal density to drop its full weight onto foes, or shifts its internal mass to absorb massive physical strikes without cracking.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Simply walking across open ground leaves deep crater-like footprints and sends low-frequency shockwaves through nearby stone bedrock.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Coordinates hundreds of individual living units instantly to form an impenetrable defensive wall capable of withstanding heavy artillery impacts without losing a single brick.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Never inspect strange stone masonry or ancient towers in areas with documented wormhole activity. If the stones begin displaying glowing red eyes, maintain distance immediately; its stomping radius can collapse surrounding terrain in seconds.

species_relations.field_context: Discovered alongside Stakataka in Ultra Wormhole incidents, serving as its volatile, erratic counterpart against Stakataka's stoic, fortress-like stillness.
Shares a synchronized multi-body command structure, though Stakataka coordinates as a vertical structure rather than a marching tactical squad.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Ultra Beast based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Emerged directly from Ultra Space through localized wormhole disruptions, operating under completely alien predatory instincts.
Triggers volatile head explosions to disorient onlookers before leeching their vital energy during moments of stunned confusion.

overview.field_thesis: Blacephalon is an invasive extra-dimensional predator that slithers toward human settlements with an unnerving, fluid gait. It mesmerizes targets with jaunty, theatrical movements before detonating its own detachable head to absorb the spilled vitality of shocked onlookers.
key_observations: Its multi-colored head is composed of dense, volatile organic compounds that ignite on command and regenerate almost instantly after detonation.
Moves with a flexible, jointless slither that allows it to silently close distances in both urban alleyways and dense wilderness.
Feeds strictly on the shock and biological vitality siphoned from living creatures during sudden, concussive blasts.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its noodle-like frame allows it to slide through tight ruins or forest canopy undetected, positioning its glowing head at eye level with curious travelers.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Hurls its own glowing head directly into combat zones, triggering massive thermal blasts while absorbing minimal physical recoil itself.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Detonations scorch soil and melt stone in a small radius while immediately chilling ambient thermal energy as it drains the surrounding life force.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Detonates its own cranial core with force equivalent to high-grade military explosives, leaving target shock-drained and paralyzed without destroying its own body.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If you observe a tall, colorful silhouette walking toward you with rhythmic, unnatural slithering movements, do not look directly at its head. Cover your ears, close your eyes, and retreat immediately.

species_relations.field_context: Shares an extra-dimensional origin in Ultra Space, frequently documented alongside it near temporary rift zones.
Competes around human settlements over ambient spiritual energy and lingering vitality drained from vulnerable targets.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Mythical Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Roams remote mountain ranges and dense wilderness alone, never maintaining a fixed den due to its extreme mobility.
Absorbs ambient atmospheric electricity and stray lightning strikes directly into its coat to magnetize its body and recharge its reserves.

overview.field_thesis: Zeraora is an exceptionally rare, nomadic electric predator that uses powerful magnetic fields to achieve instantaneous bursts of speed. It roams rugged wilderness zones, utilizing high-voltage claws to incapacitate prey and defend its massive hunting range.
key_observations: Emits sonic booms and sharp lightning flashes whenever it breaks into a full sprint across open ground.
Lacks an internal electricity-generating organ; instead, it creates potent magnetic fields by running and drawing in external electrical currents.
Discharges leftover static energy through retractable claws, creating arcs of plasma that burn target tissue even without direct contact.

primary_assets: Conductive limb pads capable of releasing high-amp discharges
Retractable hyper-sharpened claws that channel localized plasma
Densely insulated fur that absorbs ambient electrical charge
physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its insulated fur prevents self-electrocution while allowing the feline to glide effortlessly along magnetic field lines over rough mountain terrain.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Channels high voltage directly into physical strikes like Plasma Fists and Thunder Punch, rending targets while secondary lightning arcs strike adjacent threats.

innate_powers: Volt Absorption, converting incoming electric attacks into instant physical regeneration
High-frequency electromagnetic propulsion for short-distance teleportation-like speed
special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Rapid movement ionizes the surrounding air, triggering localized thunderclaps and leaving magnetic disturbances that disrupt electronic equipment for miles.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Sprints across a valley at sub-sonic speeds, tearing through dense timber with electrified claws and leaving glowing plasma arcs in the air.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If you hear sudden, inexplicable thunder under clear skies, a Zeraora is hunting nearby. Vacate the area immediately, keep metal gear concealed, and do not attempt to track its electrical trail.

species_relations.field_context: Competes with Luxray for top-predator status in open wilderness regions, frequently clashing in high-voltage territorial disputes.
Frequently fights Electivire over high-output ambient electrical sources during severe thunderstorm events.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Mythical Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Meltan actively absorbs iron particles from subsoil and urban scrap, circulating the fluid metal through its core to generate bio-electrical power.
Individual Meltan roam in large, cohesive groups that coordinate their feeding before eventual amalgamation into a single dominant organism.

overview.field_thesis: Meltan is an amorphous metallic creature composed of liquid steel anchored by a brass hex-nut head that acts as its central focal point. It spends its days dissolving metal scrap and subsoil iron deposits directly into its fluid body to sustain its circulation and generate internal electrical charge.
key_observations: Absorbs raw iron and manufactured metals into its body using corrosive liquid chemistry.
Uses its tail-like wire appendage to pick up magnetic signatures and channel static charges.
Gathers in compact groups, pooling shared metal reserves until one individual assimilates the rest to evolve.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its fluid cellular structure allows Meltan to slip into microscopic gaps within machinery and dissolve metal structural joints from the inside out.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Physical strikes roll off its liquid torso effortlessly, while it can rapidly harden its metallic core to blunt blunt-force impacts.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: A lingering Meltan pack can entirely strip buried pipes, discarded tools, and subsoil mineral veins, leaving behind trace magnetic hotspots.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: By accelerating the internal circulation of its liquid steel core, Meltan can project blinding pulses of light and concentrated beam attacks directly through its hex-nut head.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: While docile toward humans, Meltan will casually dissolve and eat field gear, belt buckles, lanterns, and iron cookware if left unwatched near camp.

species_relations.field_context: Tinkaton aggressively hunt down Meltan swarms to harvest their high-grade molten steel cores for forge material.
Both species compete in urban scrap heaps and junkyards for rich iron refuse and discarded motor components.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Mythical Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Generates unmatched kinetic torque by spinning its massive liquid-steel arms and solid hex-nut fists using centrifugal acceleration.
Persisted through a 3,000-year slumber, preserving an ancient anatomical structure that dissolves back into individual Meltan upon death.

overview.field_thesis: Melmetal is an immense, ancient guardian formed when hundreds of Meltan fuse their liquid-metal bodies into a single cohesive organism. It wanders quiet mountain ruins and deep subterranean caverns, converting natural mineral deposits into dense iron plating.
key_observations: Its frame consists primarily of fluid mercury-like steel, giving its limbs complete elasticity around solid structural hex nuts.
At the end of its life, its outer shell oxidizes into rust and crumbles, seeding the surrounding soil with hundreds of new Meltan.
Ancient human settlements venerated this creature as a divine benefactor due to its habit of creating pure iron from scrap ore.

primary_assets: Solid-iron hex nut wrist and shoulder anchors
physical_arsenal.field_utility: Flexible fluid joints allow it to absorb heavy impacts without fracture and deform its shape to squeeze through tight cavern passages.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: By rapidly spinning its upper body, it converts the weight of its heavy nut-fists into devastating centrifugal strikes that shatter rock faces.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Leaves trails of heavily magnetized metallic residue behind, causing nearby compass needles to spin erratically.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Drives both massive hex-nut fists into targets with rotational speeds so high that the kinetic impact creates localized shockwaves.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: While generally peaceful and indifferent to travelers, a single stray swing from its heavy liquid-metal arms can be catastrophic. Maintain a thirty-foot clearance if it begins spinning its upper torso.

species_relations.field_context: Melmetal is born from the merging of countless Meltan and eventually breaks down to re-seed the local population upon its death.
Swarms of Durant frequently attempt to scrape iron dust and shedding metal flakes from Melmetal's outer limbs to build their tunnels.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Starter Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Keeps a carved, energy-infused stick securely tucked into its head tuft, using it as an instrument, forage tool, and weapon.
Rhythmic soundwaves generated by its drumming transmit vitalizing energy that rapidly blooms withered flowers and enriches forest soil.

overview.field_thesis: Grookey is an endlessly energetic forest primate that channels its natural life force through a specialized wooden stick to stimulate plant growth. It thrives in high canopy troops, filling the woods with rhythmic drumming that keeps surrounding vegetation lush and vibrant.
key_observations: Stores its prized stick inside its fur head tuft, where absorbed body warmth and bio-energy continually condition the wood.
Rhythmic stick-tapping creates localized acoustic vibrations that cause nearby dormant plant buds to bloom within minutes.
Exhibits heightened aggression and speed the faster it drums, entering a rhythmic trance during competitive displays.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Densely packed limb muscles allow it to spring effortlessly between tree branches while maintaining a lock-tight grip on its wooden tool.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Delivers rapid-fire stick strikes that gain momentum with every hit, overwhelming opponents through sheer tempo and jarring percussion.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Frequent drumming sessions revitalize nutrient-depleted topsoil and accelerate forest canopy growth in its immediate territory.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: A sustained drumming routine by a single Grookey can fully restore a patch of drought-withered forest wildflowers overnight.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Grookey are generally harmless to travelers, but their intense curiosity means unattended gear, wooden walking sticks, or snacks may be drummed on or stolen.

species_relations.field_context: Grookey frequently drum on hollow log caches to startle Greedent into dropping their hoarded berries.
Competes for prime nesting branches in the lower forest canopy, often driving away young birds with loud rhythmic tapping.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Starter Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Thwackey selects and shapes sturdy wooden sticks from specific canopy trees, stowing them embedded in its head fur until needed for drumming or defense.

overview.field_thesis: Thwackey is an extraordinarily active canopy dweller that lives in a state of near-constant percussive vibration, using paired wooden sticks to communicate and fight. Its social hierarchy is determined entirely by drumming tempo, with faster beats earning greater authority within the troop.
key_observations: Keeps twin high-density wooden sticks wedged firmly in its upper head crest when not actively drumming.
Enters an almost trance-like state during rapid battle tempos, often continuing to strike long after its opponent has been rendered unconscious.
Measures social prestige strictly by cadence, with the fastest drummers taking point on foraging routes.

primary_assets: Flexible wrist joints and high-dexterity digits
physical_arsenal.field_utility: The twin sticks serve both as acoustic signaling instruments across dense canopy and as blunt implements for peeling bark, cracking nuts, and probing hollow trees.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: By applying hyper-rapid dual-stick strikes in blistering tempos, it delivers continuous bludgeoning strikes that easily shatter defensive barriers.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Continuous rhythmic drumming sends micro-vibrations through surrounding tree branches, stimulating foliage growth and driving burrowing insects out into the open.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Can sustain a uninterrupted 300-beats-per-minute percussive sequence, driving its twin sticks through thick wood through sheer kinetic speed.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Exercise caution if you hear rapid, rhythmic tapping in the forest canopy. A Thwackey swept up in a drumming rhythm loses situational awareness and may accidentally strike travelers who wander into its swinging arc.

species_relations.field_context: Younger Grookey observe and mimic Thwackey's dual-stick rhythm to refine their own single-stick drumming techniques.
Thwackey yields dominance to Rillaboom, whose deep bass trunk-drumming completely overwhelms their high-tempo double-stick beats.
Thwackey troops regularly dispute canopy boundaries with Passimian bands, using loud percussive beat bursts to disrupt their organized tactical passes.

classifications.justification: Sets Grassy Terrain to grant passive recovery, halve Earthquake damage, and power up priority Grassy Glide. Access to Fake Out, U-turn momentum, and Wood Hammer wallbreaking makes it the premier offensive grass pivot.
Classified as a Starter Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Carries a specialized wooden tree stump and twin drumsticks, utilizing them continuously as both musical instruments and bio-acoustic weapons.
Directs troop movements, defines territorial borders, and maintains social harmony through intricate percussive beat patterns across dense canopy.

overview.field_thesis: Rillaboom is a massive canopy primate that governs its forest territory through percussive rhythm and gentle social leadership. By striking its specialized tree stump, it generates bio-acoustic resonance that direct living plant roots and revitalize surrounding vegetation.
key_observations: Troop dominance is determined purely by percussive skill and rhythmic control rather than raw brute strength.
The tree stump carried by Rillaboom contains living root tissue that responds dynamically to sound vibrations.
Despite its heavy build and tremendous power, it maintains a gentle nature and avoids unnecessary conflict.

primary_assets: Dense muscular upper body capable of heavy crushing impacts
Bio-energetic wooden stump lined with responsive root fibers
Twin high-density wood drumsticks shaped for maximum kinetic transfer
physical_arsenal.field_utility: Emits distinct percussive cadences across miles of dense forest to navigate terrain, mark borders, and signal troop members.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Pounds rhythmic sequences into its drum to channel kinetic shockwaves that smash heavy defenses and shatter rock.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Rhythmic soundwaves stimulate dormant flora, inducing rapid grass growth and soil enrichment across the surrounding forest floor.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Directs a intense percussive cadence into its stump to cause massive underground roots to burst upward and strike under its absolute command.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: If deep percussive drumming echoes through the woods, keep your distance and avoid disturbing the troop's ritual. While naturally peaceful, Rillaboom will fiercely defend its group with deafening sonic shockwaves if it feels its family harmony is threatened.

species_relations.field_context: Both are highly organized social primates, though Rillaboom coordinates through rhythmic forest sound while Passimian relies on tactical physical signals.
Rillaboom frequently chases off foraging Greedent that attempt to steal berries or stash nuts inside their hollow tree drums.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Starter Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: Frequently initiates spontaneous sprints and cheeky high-speed dashes around travelers to build up the body heat needed to ignite its internal fire.
Rapid shifts in its footwork and sprint tempo allow it to dynamically alter its movement rhythms and tactical posture mid-battle.

overview.field_thesis: Scorbunny is a hyperkinetic lagomorph that relies on continuous running to pump thermal energy through its body. Once its specialized footpads reach critical temperatures, it converts that kinetic friction into blistering, flame-coated kicks.
key_observations: Specialized pads on the soles of its feet and nose radiate intense surface heat when its pulse accelerates.
Continuous sprint warm-ups act as a biological pump, converting physical movement into volatile internal ignition.
Leaves small, distinct singe marks across grassy paths whenever it accelerates into top speed.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Spring-like leg tendons allow it to leap over tall prairie grass with ease, while its heated nose pad helps regulate core temperature during long runs.
physical_arsenal.combat_application: Focuses thermal output directly through the soles of its feet, transforming standard leaping strikes like High Jump Kick into scorching impact strikes.

special_capabilities.environmental_impact: Sprinting across dry grasslands during summer months can leave trailing lines of smoldering embers along its track.
special_capabilities.signature_feat: Reaches thermal equilibrium during a full sprint, causing its footpads to flash-ignite dry grass with every stride.

field_hazard_advisory.traveler_warning: Exercise caution when walking through dry pastureland. A startled Scorbunny taking off at full speed can inadvertently drop hot embers into dry brush.

species_relations.field_context: Scorbunny actively aggressively chases away prowling Nickit that attempt to raid its burrows or steal scavenged food.
While Wooloo quietly graze in Galarian pastures, hyperactive Scorbunny frequently scatter the herds during their restless warm-up runs.

classifications.justification: Classified as a Starter Pokémon based on documented regional field observations.

behavioral_badges.field_citation: By retaining internal body heat within its heavy fur coat, Raboot dramatically intensifies the temperature of the internal thermal core fueling its flame moves.

overview.field_thesis: Raboot is an intensely focused woodland traveler that spends its days honing precise leg strikes on falling foliage and tree-borne fruit. Disdaining hand strikes in favor of tucked-in efficiency, it maintains an aloof demeanor while relentlessly refining its footwork.
key_observations: Drives berries down from high branches using snappy, low-profile kicks, then seamlessly juggles them in midair.
Keeps both front paws permanently tucked into its dense torso fleece to minimize drag and conserve body warmth.
Insulating fur coat keeps it completely unbothered by freezing winter frosts while priming its combustion organ.

physical_arsenal.field_utility: Its dense coat maintains constant thermal equilibrium across freezing nights, while its muscular hindquarters allow effortless canopy-high leaps to knock down food.
